application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of condition SuDS (14) of planning permission ref: 25/00268/FUL as the proposed Drainage Strategy fails to demonstrate how proposed measures appropriately utilise Sustainable Urban Drainage Systems (SuDS) following the drainage hierarchy in the London Plan. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies SI12 and SI13 of the London Plan (2021), CP28 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and DMD61 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 25/00268/FUL: external materials (3) and SuDS (14) in respect of demolition of 28 Drapers Road and construction of replacement house with 8 x dwelling houses to the rear of 28-36 Drapers Road, with widening of existing vehicular access, hardstanding, associated amenity, parking and cycle storage.
